messages:
incident-bot: Pager duty: P1 triggered for embeddings-serving-eu-west-1 — error-rate spike and 5xxs. Incident page: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD12345 Affected: Hosted embeddings endpoint for search. Please acknowledge and follow runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-p1
Sam P: ack'd — I'm oncall until 23:50 UTC, currently driving this one. Quick summary: ~4% of embedding requests are 5xx from the eu-west cluster, latency OK for the rest. Error logs show decoder OOMs on a small subset of GPU workers.
Ivy R: thanks Sam. I'm incoming at 23:45 UTC (10m). Can you hand off driver to me? Happy to take engineering driver but would like Sam to stay comms for the next 15m to avoid duplicate customer messages.
Sam P: yeah that's the plan. I'll swap driver -> Ivy now. I'm keeping comms until 23:55 to finish the customer note thread and brief infra. Ivy, steps I did already: throttled retries at edge, pinned model variant to v1.12 on routing to reduce mem usage, and removed two suspect pods from service.
Ivy R: got it. I'm stepping in as driver. First actions: (1) check node-level OOM patterns, (2) confirm model variant routing is stable, (3) run KV-cache warmup check. If we still see 5xxs, we roll traffic to fallback model vm-safe-quant.
Jorge L: FYI I'll be comms backup if Sam needs to step away. I can draft the external customer status update after Sam posts initial note.
Maya S: SRE here — can we get kubectl and node logs? Also prepare to scale up a spare GPU pool if rolling restart is needed.
Sam P: logs pasted below — truncated.
```
2025-11-07T23:38:12Z embeddings-worker-22 stderr: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory while allocating kernel
2025-11-07T23:38:13Z embeddings-worker-23 stderr: decoder failed to allocate kv cache at step 512
2025-11-07T23:38:13Z gateway-01 access: 200 /embed  154ms
2025-11-07T23:38:14Z gateway-02 access: 502 /embed  28ms
```
Ivy R: thanks. I'll run a targeted drain of node-22 and node-23, then bring them back sequentially. Command I'm running:
```
kubectl cordon node-22 && kubectl drain node-22 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
kubectl get pods -n embeddings -o wide | grep node-22
```
Sam P: +1 on cordon/drain. Also check GPU driver versions on those nodes — there was a recent kernel patch on node-22.
Maya S: I'll pre-warm the fallback pool and stand up two extra instances in eu-west-1. If Ivy needs, we can do traffic reroute:
```
# reroute to fallback model
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  https://api.redwood.internal/route-control -d '{"route":"embeddings-eu-west","model":"vm-safe-quant","weight":1.0}'
```
Ivy R: doing the drain now. Running health checks after evict. If drain succeeds and 5xxs drop, we'll keep Sam as comms and I'll own engineering actions.
Sam P: drafting customer-facing note: "We're investigating a partial regression in embeddings in eu-west-1. Some requests receive 502/5xx. We're actively rolling affected nodes and preparing fallback model routing. ETA next update in 15 minutes." Posting in #status-updates when ready.
Jorge L: +1. I'll watch the support queue and paste the note after Sam posts. I'll also escalate to enterprise CS contacts for any open high-touch customers.
Ivy R: drain complete on node-22, pod evictions look clean, launching health-checks. Initial traffic spike of 5xxs reduced from 4% -> 1.1% after cordon/drain.
Sam P: nice — that's promising. I'm going offline for a quick call at 23:48 but will keep Slack audible for comms. Jorge will take any customer pings until I return. Ivy, if error-rate doesn't drop below 0.5% in 10m, escalate to full rollback to vm-safe-quant and notify Maya.
Maya S: standing by — preparing rollback playbook and capacity. If Ivy triggers rollback, I'll run the route change and watch backend utilization.
incident-bot: Note logged: "ownership_change: engineering_driver -> Ivy R at 3024000030; comms_owner -> Sam P until 3024000355"
Ivy R: copying the runbook pointer for next steps: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-p1#node-drain-and-fallback Also adding a quick checklist: [x] cordon+drain node-22, [x] health-checks green, [ ] monitor 10m for regression, [ ] rollback to vm-safe-quant if >0.5% 5xxs.
Sam P: leaving final comms in 2m. Ivy: take driver and I'll remain comms until 23:55 UTC, then full handoff. Jorge/Maya — thanks for cover.
Jorge L: copying the incident timeline to the support thread and tagging CS. :thumbsup:
Ivy R: acknowledged. I'll update incident page and post engineering progress every 5 minutes.
incident-bot: Automated: "shift_transition recorded: incoming_oncall Ivy R acknowledged at 3024000065; outgoing_oncall Sam P marked comms_owner until 3024000355.""
